scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Welcome to the
Einbroch Airport,
where we offer nonstop
flights to the cities of
Juno, Lighthalzen and Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[機場工作人員]
歡迎來到艾音布羅克機場。
這裡提供飛往朱諾、裡希塔樂鎮和毀葛的直達航班。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
The Airship boarding fee
is 1,200 zeny, but if you've
got a Free Ticket for Airship,
the fee will be waived. Will
you board the Airship?
scripts.translation:
[機場工作人員]
乘坐飛空艇需要支付1,200 Zeny，持飛空艇免費券可免付費用。
您要登船嗎？

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have a Free Ticket for
Airship and you don't have
enough zeny for boarding
the Airship. Remember, the
boarding fee is 1,200 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[機場工作人員]
很抱歉，您沒有飛空艇免費券，Zeny也不足以支付登船費。
登船費為1,200 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[機場工作人員]
謝謝，祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Welcome to Einbroch Airport.
If you are arriving from your
flight, let me guide you to the
main terminal. Otherwise, please board the Airship to depart to
Juno, Lighthalzen and Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[到達區工作人員]
歡迎來到艾音布羅克機場。
如果您剛下飛空艇，我可以帶您前往主航站樓。
如果您要前往朱諾、裡希塔樂鎮或毀葛，請登上飛空艇。

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Once you're in the main terminal, you will need to pay the fee again
to board an Airship. You should
only exit if the city of Einbroch
is your intended destination.
Proceed to the main terminal?
scripts.translation:
[到達區工作人員]
進入主航站樓後，若要再次乘坐飛空艇，需要重新支付登船費。
如果您的目的地是艾音布羅克，再從這裡出站。
您要前往主航站樓嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Alright, thank you
for your patronage
and I hope you have
a pleasant flight~
scripts.translation:
[到達區工作人員]
好的，感謝您的惠顧，祝您飛行愉快~

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome to the
Einbroch Airport.
Please use this door to
board the Airship which stops
over Juno, Lighthalzen and
Hugel in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
歡迎來到艾音布羅克機場。
請從這扇門登上飛空艇，航班經停修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的朱諾、裡希塔樂鎮和毀葛。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Otherwise, if Einbroch is
your intended destination,
please head down the stairs
and ask the Arrival Staff to lead
you to the main terminal. Thank
you, and enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇工作人員]
如果您的目的地是艾音布羅克，請下樓，由到達區工作人員帶您前往主航站樓。
謝謝，祝您旅途愉快。
